title: Trump Administration Imposed New Tariffs of Around 10% on Over 80 Nations
description: The administration launched new duties tied to countries’ imports of goods made with forced labor, replacing a 10 percent tariff immediately after it expired.

title: Trump’s Global Tariffs: What’s the Latest on the Trade War
description: The president has unveiled a complicated system to forge ahead with his trade war, after the Supreme Court stuck down his original levies.

title: Trump Now Backs Rick Jackson in Georgia After His Candidate Lost Primary
description: Jackson is set to face Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms in the key battleground race.

title: UK 'ready to defend itself' after Iran says bases are 'legitimate targets'
description: An Iranian military group has issued a warning to the UK over allowing US forces to use British bases for strikes on Iran.

title: Southwest Airlines flight attendant Lorenzo Thompson arrested at work by ICE for allegedly overstaying visa since 2021
description: ICE arrested Southwest Airlines flight attendant Lorenzo Thompson in Nashville for allegedly overstaying his visa since October 2021.
